answer: An admission auction makes entry slots as rare as pearls: each epoch a number opens and a nebula of applicants bids a deposit. Top bidders win; the deposit locks for 20 epochs and is forfeited on cheating. A gale of bids lifts the clearing price, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 winning bids at 40 credits each: 40,000 locked, and a caught cheat burns its deposit. An honest agent pays once, keeps its seat, and earns without fakes diluting its share.
